blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — A network of lawyers in Mindanao has strongly condemned the dawn assassination of a Basilan regional trial court judge in Zamboanga City, calling the ambush a “chilling strike” against the region’s judiciary. Judge Joseph Wee Sit of the Regional Trial Court (RTC) Branch 2 in Basilan was driving through Barangay Tumaga shortly after 5 a.m. on Thursday when two men on a motorcycle drove up beside his vehicle and opened fire. Initial police reports indicated that investigators found his car riddled with bullet holes and recovered eight spent shell casings at the crime scene. READ: Hataman […]...
